cohort: The study involved 334 neonates (111 cases with low birth weight and 223 controls with normal birth weight) born at Halaba General Hospital in Halaba Zone, southern Ethiopia, between October 2023 and February 2024.
finding: Illiteracy, rural residence, gestational age <37 weeks, maternal MUAC <23 cm, maternal weight gain <12 kg, and various frequencies of maternal khat use (monthly, weekly, daily) were identified as independent predictors of low birth weight.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was the primary outcome for cases, with controls being normal birth weight neonates; specific weight thresholds for classification are not provided.
gest_age: Babies of varying gestational ages were included, with gestational age <37 weeks identified as a significant risk factor for low birth weight.
